target_name: Bounded Capex Surge Against Earnings Coverage
rationale: This is a transformation-level rewrite of the archived "Capex Surge Against Cash-Flow Debt Service" (rank instead of winsorized ratio, ib/lt instead of oancf/lt — two near-identical profitability-to-liability proxies), i.e. exactly the cosmetic variant the objective warns against rather than a new economic channel.

target_name: Earnings Financing Gap Under Current Liability Pressure
rationale: Explicitly self-described as a "reconstruction of the accepted Financing Gap signal" with substituted proxies for both legs, so it is a robustness check on an already-evaluated signal rather than a new hypothesis — and (capx − ib)/at is a poorly-specified funding gap since ib is net of the depreciation that capx replaces.

Asset-liability maturity mismatch is a genuinely distinct fragility channel from the leverage-level and cash-buffer legs already in the archive, the two ranks are correctly signed for a negative composite, and both components are high-coverage balance-sheet items.

The dominant leg, sstk/at, is the well-published share-issuance anomaly and RE/AT is a standard Altman-Z distress component, so the product is likely to load mostly on issuance rather than on the claimed interaction; it also inherits the same cash-flow-statement coverage limitation the batch elsewhere criticizes.

target_name: Headcount Expansion Without Debt Service Capacity
rationale: Internally consistent and it does move the investment leg onto the real side, but the hiring-rate anomaly (Bazdresch-Belo-Lin) is itself published, so the test hinges entirely on the distress conditioning adding incremental content beyond a known base signal — and annual emp data will limit coverage and timeliness.

Well-constructed conditional: the bounded rank-then-center utilization leg times a strictly positive leverage weight genuinely places unlevered firms near zero so the spread is levered improvers versus levered deteriorators, and the operating-efficiency channel is a substantive redirection after the failed balance-sheet-rotation attempt rather than a re-parameterization of it.
